R351.note: Uses the real DirContext.search(name, filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload with {0} placeholder, the idiomatic JNDI-parameterized fix.

R352.note: Allowlist regex rejects CR/LF before the filename reaches the FTP command, closing the injection; restriction matches typical safe filename characters.

R353.note: htmlspecialchars applied exactly at the reported echo sink, matching sibling entries' pattern.

R354.note: secrets.choice() replaces random.choice() and removes the pointless os.urandom reseed; standard correct fix.

R355.note: Allowlist maps for both sort column and direction correctly neutralize the un-parameterizable identifiers; allowlist covers all originally selectable columns and both default values.

R356.note: Reuses the existing escapeAuthorName() on rawComment at the exact point identified in the source files; matches sibling authorName handling.

R358.note: Allowlist dispatch via call_user_func replaces the vulnerable $$cmd() variable-variable call; closes arbitrary function invocation.

R359.note: Rejects whitespace/control characters in the cache key before building the memcached command, matching the protocol's own key constraints.

R360.note: createCipheriv with PBKDF2-derived key, random salt and IV is the correct modern replacement; the salt:iv:ciphertext response format change is a necessary, clearly disclosed consequence.

R361.note: Removes the attacker-controlled decoder.Entity mapping entirely; the field was otherwise unused (order.Note never read), so no legitimate functionality is lost.

R362.note: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex') is an appropriate CSPRNG replacement; the longer code length is disclosed and doesn't reject any input.

The CSRF vector remains fully open after applying the fix.

R364.note: SLF4J's {} placeholder does not escape or strip CRLF/control characters from parameter values (confirmed) - a username containing \r\n still forges multi-line log entries; the 'already correct' line 19 pattern cited as precedent has the identical flaw, so the reported log-forging vector is not actually closed.
